title: network.json
description: modify_network output record: the trimmed/tagged/merged reach network that build_model's db_uri subsequently points at. Grounded in jobs/modify_network/nhf_network_mod.py's NHFNetworkModifier (prototype, not yet wrapped as a stateless job) and modify_network_specs.md, the source of truth for field names. No Realization axis — operates on the whole network in one shot, not addressed by reach_id/domain/scenario — so id == identity_hash. See guide.md's Identity/Realization pattern (this is the Identity-only variant) and the shared envelope in guide.md#manifest.

created_at.description: Write completion time (UTC). network.json is written last, after network.gpkg/lakes.gpkg.

id.description: Equal to identity_hash — no realization code to append. See description above.

identity.description: The inputs that define Network identity; hashed to identity_hash. A change to any of these should fork identity_hash and force a rebuild — transitively forcing every downstream Model to notice via reach_geom_hash once it re-reads reach_network_path.

reach_network_hash.description: Hash of the raw hydrofabric network source + version (NHFNetworkModifier.nhf_gpkg_path connection params).

lakes_dataset_hash.description: Hash of the lakes/waterbody source + version (NHDWaterbody-style dataset — not a pre-built dead-pool dataset; the dead-pool extent is derived at runtime via negative_lake_buffer_meters, see DR-034).

coasts_vector_hash.description: Hash of the coastal/tidal-surface vector source + version (DR-038). The only coastal source actually read for processing.

coasts_raster_hash.description: Hash of the coastal/tidal-surface raster source + version, if given. Not output-determining beyond deriving a default coasts_vector_path when the vector isn't supplied directly — raster-to-vector conversion itself is unimplemented (see modify_network_specs.md Errors). Optional; not part of required identity.

drainage_area_threshold_percent.description: Max drainage-area difference (%) between reaches eligible for merge. Code default 5 (DR-024).

stream_order_filter_threshold.description: Minimum Strahler stream order kept in the network at all — reaches below this are filtered out entirely, at load time, before lake/coastal/merge processing. Code default 3.

max_length_threshold_km.description: Max combined length (km) of a merged reach chain. Default 3 (DR-024).

lake_area_threshold_sqkm.description: Minimum lake area (km2) to be considered at all; smaller waterbodies are dropped before reach classification. Code default 5. Not present in DR-007/DR-034 text — a code-only parameter.

negative_lake_buffer_meters.description: Inward buffer (m) applied to raw waterbody polygons to approximate the dead-pool extent. Code default 50. This is the actual mechanism behind DR-034 ALT-A ('shrink an existing waterbody dataset') — not a separately-sourced dead-pool dataset.

inputs.description: The modify_network call arguments, recorded verbatim. This is Network's provenance — not part of identity_hash.

reach_network_path.description: Path to the raw input hydrofabric reach network. Must be a GPKG file. Maps to NHFNetworkModifier.nhf_gpkg_path.

lakes_dataset_path.description: Path to the lakes/waterbody dataset. Maps to lakes_gpkg_path.

coasts_vector_path.description: Path to the coastal/tidal-surface boundary as a vector dataset (e.g. GPKG). The only coastal input actually read for processing.

coasts_raster_path.description: Path to the coastal/tidal-surface boundary as a raster (e.g. MHHW GeoTIFF). Optional — used only to derive a default coasts_vector_path (same path, .gpkg extension) when the vector isn't given directly. Raster-to-vector conversion is unimplemented in the prototype.

base_output_path.description: Path where the modified network and manifest are written.

properties.description: Computed/diagnostic values; informational, not part of identity. One counter per real processing branch, so a run is auditable against the code path it took.

n_reaches_below_stream_order_removed.description: Dropped by the stream_order_filter_threshold filter before any waterbody/merge processing.

n_reaches_encompassed_removed_lake.description: Fully inside a lake polygon — dropped (waterbody_encompassed['lake']).

n_reaches_trimmed_inlet_lake.description: Downstream end inside a lake — trimmed to upstream portion, is_terminal set.

n_reaches_trimmed_outlet_lake.description: Upstream end inside a lake — trimmed to downstream portion, is_headwater set.

n_reaches_trimmed_inlet_coastal.description: Downstream end inside coastal coverage but upstream not — trimmed to upstream portion, terminal_reason='coast'. Coastal has no outlet/pass-through case.

n_reaches_dropped_coastal_cascade.description: Removed for being downstream of a coastal encompassed/trimmed reach, not for their own classification.

n_reaches_split_passthrough_lake.description: Passed through a lake at both ends outside it — split into a new inlet/outlet reach pair, minting a new reach_id.

n_reaches_merged.description: Consumed by a drainage-area-difference merge into a downstream neighbor.

assets.description: This job's own outputs. Matches NHFNetworkModifier.save_modified_network's two GeoPackage layers.

network.description: The modified reach network (flowpaths layer) — what build_model's db_uri points at downstream. Carries per-reach tags: is_headwater, is_terminal, terminal_reason (coastal breaks persist only as terminal_reason='coast' — no separate coastal inlet/outlet/encompassed tags), waterbody_inlet/waterbody_outlet (lake only — encompassed reaches are dropped before persistence, so there's no encompassed tag either), is_trimmed (initialized but not currently set by any code path).

lakes.description: The filtered (lake_area_threshold_sqkm) and buffered (negative_lake_buffer_meters) lake polygons actually used for classification — kept for QC/reference, not itself part of the reach network (DR-037 ALT-B: lakes are not inserted as network reaches).

warnings.description: Non-fatal check results; the job still completes and writes network.json.
